title: 渲染层：软边图集 + ImageBitmap + contain + 按需停帧

searched.q: offscreen canvas sprite pre-render / createImageBitmap canvas sprite sheet
searched.takeaway: Pre-render dots offscreen; avoid shadowBlur; do not scale in drawImage; createImageBitmap is Baseline and the MDN sprite-sheet example.

searched.q: canvas sub-pixel rendering / imageSmoothingEnabled / clearRect vs fillRect / devicePixelRatio
searched.takeaway: Integer drawImage coords; keep default smoothing (true) for soft dots; clearRect for transparent canvas. Handbook forbids alpha:false despite MDN tip — grid must punch through.

searched.q: render on demand canvas / cancelAnimationFrame / dirty flag
searched.takeaway: Cancel rAF when idle; on wake reset lastTime/acc so the pause is not caught up.

red_lines: No per-frame ctx.arc / getImageData / WebGL / shadowBlur.
Default N=12000; only ?fx=lite is the debug cap.
